entries.citation_rule: CITE THE PDF BY PAGE NUMBER ONLY (e.g. 'Rabinovich 2014, p.4'). NEVER cite md:NN line numbers.
entries.hazard: The companion .md was a hand-written PARAPHRASE until 2026-07-09T23:58:17Z (preserved as *.md.bak-20260709T235817Z, 245 lines). It was then replaced by a PDF text-extract (494 lines). BOTH are unsafe for load-bearing claims: (a) the paraphrase invented structure the paper does not have and mis-stated Def 7.5 as a 'half-open interval'; (b) the current extract DROPS EVERY DISPLAYED EQUATION — Def 3.1 reads 'is a formula of the form:' followed by a blank line, as does Lemma 5.1 (~10 such truncations) — and semantically inverts 'k != m' to 'k = m' at md:199. Consequently ALL md:NN citations across this repo now dangle, including 89 in-code citations in Theories/Bimodal/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/Kamp/NfMultiAnchorBridge/SharedWitness.lean (md:77 x27, md:168 x24, md:154 x9, md:72 x8, md:61 x6, ...). Those 89 are KNOWN and deliberately left unfixed for now; do not trust them.
known_corrections: Lemma 3.2 (p.4) is prefaced 'It is clear that' and has NO PRINTED PROOF anywhere in the 16 pages. Do not attribute any mechanism to 'the proof of Lemma 3.2(1)'.

The tie-collapse (coincident witnesses merge to one slot whose type is the CONJUNCTION of the tied types) is FORCED BY Definition 3.1 (p.4): the witness chain is strict (xn > ... > x0) and the pinning indices i0..im in {0..n} carry no distinctness requirement. Corroborated by the k=m case split (p.7) and Def 7.5 (p.13).
Mandated citation form: 'the construction forced by Def 3.1 (p.4), corroborated by the k=m split (p.7) and Def 7.5 (p.13); Lemma 3.2(1) (p.4) states the closure without printed proof.'
Def 7.5 (p.13) is NOT a half-open interval restriction; it is a 3-alternative definition including z0 > z1 and z0 = z1.
